checks.fix: Add a Content-Security-Policy header. It tells the browser which sources of scripts and images are allowed, which helps stop injected code. A simple start is: default-src 'self'.

checks.name: Strict-Transport-Security is set
checks.fix: Add a Strict-Transport-Security header (for example max-age=31536000) so browsers always use the secure https version of the website.
